newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Hub natgas ends higher ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Hub natgas ends higher ahead of holiday.

text.p: NYMEX Hub gas futures ended near session highs Thursday, but trading remained very light ahead of the long holiday weekend, sources said.

May finished 4.5 cents higher at $1.928 per mmBtu, reaching a high of $1.935 but showing reluctance to touch next resistance at $1.97. June settled up 3.2 cents at $1.96, while other deferreds remained up slightly at the close.
"The May contract was able to probe above yesterday's high, but stalled out into the further congestion in front of last week's $1.97 high," one source said.
NYMEX will be closed tomorrow in observance of Good Friday.
NYMEX's 12-month strip rose 2.7 cents to $2.093, as an estimated 15,746 Hub contracts traded.

Technically, support in May remained at $1.86. Further support was pegged at Monday's low of $1.825 and at $1.78 and the contract low of $1.71. Resistance was now seen at at $1.95 and last Thursday's high of $1.97. Further resistance was pegged at $2.04-2.05.

Gulf Coast cash prices still clutched onto futures, as most Henry Hub deals for the remainder of March were done at $1.90 and $1.91 today. April was notionally steady to lower at $1.82-1.85. Swing and April prices on the Midco pipes were in convergence in the low-to-mid $1.70s, while Katy held around $1.85 for the weekend. At the New York city-gate, April pricing was flat at $2.17-2.20.

Normal to above-normal temperatures are expected to continue throughout most of the U.S. through the weekend, with slightly cooler weather seen arriving in the Midwest and Northeast this weekend and into early next week.
No Permian or Alberta natgas futures traded.
On KCBT, May ended four cents higher at $1.75. Deferreds were on average up three cents. The East/West spread narrowed by 0.2 cent to 17.8 cents (NYMEX premium).
Cash prices in the Permian basin for the remainder of March were talked higher in the low-$1.70s, while April business was done in the mid-to-high $1.60s.
